name: the-sporve-web
description: Sporv web app. Python builds the single-file browser surface; Node powers the same-origin AI endpoint and contract tests.
comment: playwright is deliberately NOT a dependency here. It is the CI browser harness only, installed by .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml at a pinned version. Listing it would make Vercel install ~300MB of devDependencies on every production build for something production never runs.
